title: Boss Level 1: The Bill Splitter

ai_pair_moment.flaw: The AI wrote tip = bill * tip_percent and said a 10 percent tip on 48 would print 4.80. It printed Tip: 480.00, because the percent was not divided by 100. A result worked out by hand caught it; dividing by 100 fixes it.

changes: The splitter shares the total in whole cents with // and % and reports the extra cents, instead of rounding each share, so the payments always add up to the total exactly.
The tip percent and the number of people are whole numbers (int), and the bill is a float, to keep each conversion clear.
Test runs of the finished program are copies of bill_splitter.py in examples/ (test_*.py), each with its own .stdin file, because one program file can have only one set of typed answers.
Refusing zero people needs if, which arrives in Chapter 6. The project shows the ZeroDivisionError as a test that breaks the program, and the clear prompt as the fix for now.
outstanding_issues: The traceback for the zero-people test shows the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
